pages.text: Returns the hexadecimal text of an integer.$(br2)Letters are uppercase. Negative numbers use two's complement, so -1 becomes FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF.
$(li)$(1)value$() INTEGER: the number$(li)result $(1)result$() STRING: the hexadecimal text
$(1)CALL c0de/strings/HEX$(br)  PARAMETER value 255 ;$(br)  RESULT result hexText$()
